description: Read only. The business's Meta instant forms Taseli knows: each form's name, whether Taseli made it, its question types (never the answers), and how many leads reached Taseli from it in the last 90 days (and Meta's own count where read). Useful for 'which forms do I have?', 'is the form getting leads?'.

account.description: An ad account's name or id, to see one account only; omit for all of them.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

name: lead_forms_list

leadsInTaseli.description: Leads from it in Taseli over the last 90 days.

questionTypes.description: The kinds of questions (never the answers).

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).
